text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Narita! Narita is in the lead! Narita
Brian has
crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers and cries of joy shake the venue.
Even
though it's only the first race of the
Classic Triple
Crown, there's an
unprecedented sense of
excitement in
the air.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...What an amazing runner! I can't
believe she's
our competition this year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She made the other racers look like
amateurs.
She's just on a whole other
level...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about it... She's going
to be the
Triple Crown Champion!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going ahead. I'll be in the waiting
room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Please wait! Narita Brian! At least a few
words,
please!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
W-wait just a moment! One shot! Just
one shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I handle the press at the entrance to
avoid
causing a commotion in the
runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should hurry up and head to Narita
Brian. She
probably wants to discuss our
upcoming schedule
as well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that one racer? She
was a total
beast on that final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You mean Brian, right? I wonder if she'll
be at the
Derby too. I just messaged my
trainer that we
need to talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, today's race made quite an

impact—not only on the spectators and
reporters,
but on everyone present.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Took you long enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... I didn't want you to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is going to be here
before
we know it, so let's hurry up and
talk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Will I be competing against the same
runners as
today's Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah, what are you even saying?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No matter what others may
say, not a
single person looked down
during that race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The exhilaration of that race can only be

understood by those who were on the
turf. This is
the Classic Triple Crown—the
competition of my
generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I take back what I said before the race.
I'm going
to enjoy this year to the
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In this moment, Narita Brian seems to
possess a
passion altogether apart from
those around her.
